$comment: UserEvent types (backend-spec 5.11). client: accepted by POST /events. server: written by core itself. A breaking payload change adds a new type name (e.g. material.page.v2); payloads stay small (≤ 2 KB).

material.open.description: Opened a material (slides, notes, video, link).

material.page.description: Turned to a page of a material.

notes.step.description: Moved to a step of a notes walkthrough.

lecture.focus.description: Heartbeat while a lecture page is visible (sent at most once a minute).

flash.view.description: Looked through flashcards without rating them.

mock.answer.description: Saved an answer in a mock.

mock.graded.description: One mock item graded (questionType, outcome, firstTry).

attempt.description: A practice/notes/warm-up answer (questionType, outcome, firstTry, context).

next.step_done.description: Finished a step of Take me there.

ai.ask.description: Asked the tutor (relayed from the ai service).

admin.user_read.description: An admin looked at the account.
